أبو إسحاق إبراهيم بن إسحاق النهاوندي

notes: «عن رجل» is a gap the text does not fill: unnamed.
The Imam is written after «عن» inside the chain, so he is a narrator, not imam_in_text.
«بعض أصحابه» in the scene is not a link; the years of transmission are not names and are left out.
The leading «4 -» is a report number.
